sources.title: BioClinicalBERT: Domain-Specific Clinical NLP
sources.snippet: BioClinicalBERT is a specialized BERT variant pre-trained sequentially on large-scale biomedical texts and EHR notes, enabling nuanced clinical language understanding. It leverages the BERT-Base architecture with a WordPiece tokenizer, incorporating data from PubMed, PMC articles, and MIMIC-III records for rich contextual embeddings.
